# lib/CMakeLists.txt - build the shared library libtlpi.a.
#
# Every chapter program links against this library. Each *.c file in this
# directory belongs in the library (same assumption the original Makefile
# makes).

# error_functions.c does `#include "ename.c.inc"`, which is generated by
# Build_ename.sh. Generate it into the source directory (as the original
# Makefile does) so the quoted include resolves; the file is gitignored.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ename.c.inc
    COMMAND sh Build_ename.sh > ename.c.inc
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Build_ename.sh
    COMMENT "Generating ename.c.inc from errno.h"
)

file(GLOB LIB_SOURCES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} "*.c")

# Listing the generated header as a source makes CMake run the custom command
# before compiling any object (error_functions.c includes it).
add_library(tlpi STATIC ${LIB_SOURCES} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ename.c.inc)
